Bug Report: Login Failure After Password Reset
Summary: Users cannot log in after resetting their password.
Steps:
1. Open app
2. Reset password
3. Login with new password
Expected: Login succeeds.
Actual: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error displayed.
Log Snippet:
ERROR AuthenticationService - NullPointerException at
validateToken(TokenService.java:87)
WARN Token cache miss for userId=1245
ERROR JWT signature verification failed
Environment: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, MySQL 8.0
